objects.name: Detection technique coverage: single-letter-process-on-endpoint
objects.description: The following analytic detects processes with names consisting of a single letter, which is often indicative of malware or an attacker attempting to evade detection. This detection leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on process names and command-line executions.
